description: Reduce WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more of the training budget runs at full learning rate.
Set WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.03 to add a short LR warmup.
Reduce DEPTH from 8 to 6 and raise ASPECT_RATIO to 96 (model dim 640, 5 heads) so the smaller model sees more tokens in 300 s while keeping width.
Change WINDOW_PATTERN from "SSSL" to "SL" so half of the layers use full-context attention.
Ramp Muon momentum from 0.85 to 0.97 over the first 300 steps, then use 0.95 once warmdown begins.
Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.
Set HEAD_DIM from 128 to 64 so the model uses 12 attention heads at the same width of 512.
No change: lm_head is already initialized with std=0.001 in init_weights, so this idea would be a no-op.
Add a learnable per-head temperature (init 1.2, Adam scalar group at 0.01*SCALAR_LR) multiplying q after QK-norm.
Keep an fp32 EMA of all parameters (decay 0.999 with early-step ramp, updated via torch._foreach_lerp_ each step) and copy it into the model before final evaluation.
FA3 kernels are Hopper-only and cause an illegal memory access on the A100, so I replaced the call with PyTorch SDPA (causal, full window).
Set DEPTH to 10 (model dim 640, 5 heads) and halve DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 to avoid OOM, keeping the total batch size unchanged.
Set UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008 and WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.3 in a single run to test whether the two small gains add up.
No change: the NorMuon per-row second-moment scaling is already in the Muon step.
Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSSSSSL" so all layers use the half-context window except the final layer, which is forced to full context.
Cut TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**17 (grad accum 1 at 64x2048 tokens) for about 4x more optimizer steps in 300 s, and lower MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03.
